title: Courier Service Levels for Physician Client Accounts
content:
Specimen courier service for Physician Client Accounts is set by account class: the number of scheduled pickups each business day, the windows they fall in, the latest pickup time for same-day processing, whether an unscheduled STAT pickup can be requested, and how many extra pickups can be added in a calendar month.

## Service levels

| Account class | Scheduled pickups per business day | Pickup windows offered | Latest pickup for same-day processing | Unscheduled STAT pickup | Extra pickups that can be added per calendar month |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Independent Practice Client Account | 1 | Late afternoon | 17:00 | Not available | 4 |
| Group Practice Client Account | 2 | Midday, late afternoon | 17:30 | Not available | 6 |
| Multispecialty Medical Group Account | 3 | Morning, midday, late afternoon | 18:00 | Available | 10 |
| Federally Qualified Health Center Account | 1 | Late afternoon | 17:00 | Not available | 6 |
| Hospital Outreach Reference Account | 4 | Morning, midday, late afternoon | 20:00 | Available | 20 |
| Occupational Health Employer Account | 0 (no scheduled pickups) | None | 17:00 | Not available | 0 |

## Service level questions answered

**Which classes can request an unscheduled STAT pickup?** The Multispecialty Medical Group Account and the Hospital Outreach Reference Account. In the other four classes a STAT pickup cannot be requested.

**What does the same-day cut-off mean?** It is the latest time a specimen can be picked up for same-day processing: 17:00 for the Independent Practice, Federally Qualified Health Center and Occupational Health Employer classes, 17:30 for the Group Practice class, 18:00 for the Multispecialty Medical Group class and 20:00 for the Hospital Outreach Reference class.

**Does the Occupational Health Employer Account receive courier service?** Its class schedules no pickups, offers no pickup windows and allows no extra pickups (0 a month).

**Which class has the widest set of windows?** The Multispecialty Medical Group Account and the Hospital Outreach Reference Account are offered all three windows (morning, midday and late afternoon); the Hospital Outreach Reference Account receives 4 scheduled pickups a business day, the Multispecialty Medical Group Account 3.

## Illustration (hypothetical month)

A Group Practice Client Account may add up to 6 extra pickups in a calendar month on top of its 2 scheduled pickups each business day; a Federally Qualified Health Center Account may also add up to 6, on top of 1 scheduled late-afternoon pickup.
